To publish a real case study: copy this file to content/knowledge/<real-slug>.json, replace every bracketed [placeholder] with a real, verified fact, remove this comment and the testimonial block if no permissioned quote exists, then set status to "published". Never fill a bracket with an invented name, number or quote — leave it out entirely if the fact isn't confirmed.
